text:
julia_marketing: Quick update 1: benchmark blog + dataset publish originally planned for Thu is blocked by a last-minute regression found in the throughput numbers. Dev team says it's fixable but needs ~48h. Need plan for delaying embargo and notifying partners.

sophie_marketing: Ugh. Okay. We need a communication plan: (1) notify embargoed press list privately, (2) update the scheduling page, (3) delay syndication. Who can draft the holding note?

nate_pr: I can draft a short holding note to send to embargoed outlets. Tone: transparent, brief, no technical deep-dives. Offer to reschedule interviews.

anita_legal: Legal: flag on any claims referencing "new state-of-the-art" or specific latency figures. If numbers change, we need sign-off again. Also request we keep the reason high-level to avoid leaked details.

dev_lead: Confirmed regression: edge-case batching math caused a 6-8% drop on long-context tests. We're patching and re-running nightly; expect validated numbers in ~36-48h. No customer impact currently.

julia_marketing: Good to know no customer impact. Nate, can you send the holding note as an embargo DM to the top 20 outlets and copy this thread summary? Also add a line offering an embargoed follow-up with corrected numbers.

nate_pr: On it. Draft holding note (below). Please review quickly so I can start outreach.

```
Holding note (DRAFT):
We are postponing the publication of our performance benchmark originally scheduled for Thu to allow for a final validation pass. We expect to publish updated results within 48 hours. We appreciate your patience and will offer an embargoed briefing with the updated dataset and a spokesperson interview. Please keep this notice confidential under the existing embargo.
```

sophie_marketing: LGTM but add one sentence: "No customer-facing features are affected." Also include a tentative new publish window (date + time TBD).

julia_marketing: Also include a bullet that we will share assets (graphs + CSV) in the follow-up; partners should not repost prior numbers.

anita_legal: Approved with edits. Remove phrase "final validation pass" -> "additional validation" (less technical). Otherwise ok.

pressops_bot: Automated reminder: update the release-tracker and flip status to "delayed". Confirmed tasks to auto-notify: embargoed list, syndication partners, social queue.

ops_partner: For syndication platforms: set social hold for all scheduled posts and pause partner syndication webhooks. I'll coordinate with platform ops. ETA 1h.

nate_pr: Sending DMs now to embargoed outlets with the approved wording. I'll report back with confirmations. If any outlet pushes back and wants early access, we route to legal + dev for a brief summary call.

dev_lead: If a partner asks for technical assurance, I can do a short 15-min call but prefer to do that after re-run.

julia_marketing: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Nate 1 send embargo DMs; Ops 1 pause syndication; Sophie 1 update release page and social holds; Anita 1 quick re-clear if numbers change. Keep updates in this thread.

nate_pr: 6 outlets acknowledged and agreed to hold. Two asked for a tentative ETA; I gave 48h. I'll ping if any try to push.

pressops_bot: Action summary (auto): [nate_pr 1 notify embargo list], [ops_partner 1 pause syndication], [sophie_marketing 1 update public release page + social queue], [dev_lead 1 validate re-run]. Next checkpoint in 24h.

sophie_marketing: Appreciate the quick responses. Will post updated timeline once dev confirms re-run. Keeping this thread as the single source for all partner communications."
